architectureV13.changes: Approved D: v13 source with the rejected central bridge removed and the complete entrance-side wedge filled by a curved landing. Steps span the new connection; glass follows the outer edge.
architectureV13.denoise: Blender OIDN CPU HDR high, base-colour guide, 2px chart border preserved + 6px fade (work/architecture-v16/web/denoise_v13.py)
architectureV13.limitation: Reflection probes retain the existing sunset-v4 captures; indirect illumination was rebaked for entrance, gallery, shell and revised architecture; separated rooms retain the v15 maps.

architectureV14.changes: Remove cross-atrium shortcut; expand the existing perimeter corner from radius 1.65 m to 4.05 m; restore glass guards at the former bridge entrances.

architectureV15.changes: Fill the entire user-outlined entrance-side wedge; replace interior guards with a continuous curved outer guard; extend the existing three-step transition across the new slab width.

architectureV16.changes: One closed landing/step shell with no internal material interfaces; original spiral path with laminated glass treads and bronze central support; explicit-only camera perspective switching.

architectureV17.changes: 23 curved laminated glass treads, 64 arc segments, evaluated polished bevels, edge laminations, champagne support shoes, silicone setting pads and fixings. Original tread elevations and collision route retained.
architectureV17.lightingLimitation: Existing v16 indirect lightmaps and earlier reflection captures retained; no new GI bake for small stair details.

architectureV18.changes: Continuous expanded curved landing edge; circular short-step fronts at the preserved elevations; original simple glass following the new perimeter; tall display pier and bronze extension removed above the landing, ground artwork retained below it; restrained underside fascia. Detailed v17 glass spiral unchanged.
architectureV18.lightingLimitation: Existing sunset reflection captures retained. The five affected architecture zones have fresh indirect/practical bakes.

architectureV19.changes: Remove the marked EH52 east vestibule rear jamb and the subsequently circled Front wing curtain wall mullion.027. Extend the continuous landing to the retained FR46 soffit support; remove guard and rail across the new walking connection. Retain source materials, spiral stairs, other rooms and interactions.
